newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB indicated higher on digital news.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB indicated higher on digital news.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting were indicated 6p higher at 482-1/2p at 0812 GMT in pre-market dealings on Monday after a press report said the UK satellite venture will move ahead with digital technology.
The shares, which have lost about 31 percent of their value since hitting their peak in mid-October, stumbled to a five-month low on Friday amid concerns about growing competitive pressures.
The Financial Times said BSkyB would decide within the next couple of days to push ahead with the digital satellite television revolution by spending some 200 million stg on decoder boxes.
"Any news probably will encourage people to try to pick the bottom," said one marketmaker, adding that the shares were due for a rebound.
